order: Address five findings found in this round's review of the round-two code, while verifying that every round-one and round-two closure still holds. The reserve gate must evaluate the requested rung, not a recast rung, so a degradation recast never silently satisfies a stop condition, and disclose restrictions on every turn served through a fallback path. Replace the collapsed regular-expression glob matcher with a token-based dynamic-programming matcher, since separated wildcard runs broke the collapsed regex. Run output redaction before tail truncation only, so straddling credentials cannot leak a partial suffix. Install the trappable signal set on Windows, where one termination signal is untrappable, and document startup pruning as the recovery path. Remove every literal NUL byte left in the router source, exempt record documents from a lint by filename prefix, and isolate a review-lane test case from interference by an external tool installation on the host machine. Put that verdict into the roster without changing a word.
claims: The reserve gate evaluates the requested rung, so a degradation recast never silently satisfies a stop, with restrictions disclosed on every fallback-served turn. Glob matching moved to a token-based matcher after the collapsed regex broke on separated wildcard runs, and redaction now runs before tail truncation. Windows installs the trappable signal set, with startup pruning as the recovery path, and the stray NUL bytes are gone from the router source. The roster holds that verdict, unaltered, and verifier finished at 92 passed, while router and registry both stayed clean on this run.
